response.original_title: PFL Chicago 2: PFL Chicago: Carmouche vs. Bishop 2
response.overview: PFL Chicago 2: PFL Chicago: Carmouche vs. Bishop 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Professional Fighters League that took place on October 16, 2026, at the Wintrust Arena in Chicago, Illinois, United States. A PFL Women's Flyweight Championship for the inaugural title between former Bellator Women's Flyweight World Champion Liz Carmouche and Jena Bishop headlined the event. The pairing previously fought at PFL 9 (2025) in August 2025, where Carmouche won the 2025 PFL tournament by knockout in round three.
